therapies.name: Vamana (Therapeutic Emesis)
benefits: Eliminates excess Kapha dosha from the upper body.
Improves respiratory conditions (asthma, bronchitis).
Clears sinuses and allergies.
Helps with weight management and sluggish digestion.
therapies.duration: 1 day (main procedure), preceded by 3-7 days of Purvakarma

therapies.name: Virechana (Therapeutic Purgation)
benefits: Clears excess Pitta from the gastrointestinal tract, liver, and gallbladder.
Improves skin conditions (acne, eczema, psoriasis).
Reduces hyperacidity and acid reflux.
Relieves chronic fevers and inflammatory conditions.
therapies.duration: 1 day (main procedure), preceded by 3-7 days of Purvakarma

therapies.name: Basti (Therapeutic Enema)
benefits: Deeply pacifies Vata dosha in its main seat (colon).
Relieves constipation, gas, and bloating.
Strengthens the nervous system (helps with anxiety, insomnia).
Improves joint health and relieves lower back pain.
therapies.duration: 8-30 days (varying protocols like Kala Basti, Karma Basti)

therapies.name: Nasya (Nasal Administration)
benefits: Clears the head, neck, and sinuses.
Relieves headaches, migraines, and stiffness in the neck/shoulders.
Improves clarity of mind, memory, and sleep.
Helps with hair loss and premature graying.
contraindications: Immediately after meals, drinking water, or bathing
During acute fever or acute sinusitis (without proper guidance)

therapies.name: Raktamokshana (Blood Letting)
benefits: Purifies the blood and deeply pacifies Pitta.
Highly effective for severe skin diseases (leukoderma, severe eczema).
Relieves localized pain and inflammation (gout).
Improves liver and spleen function.
contraindications: Extreme weakness or very young/old age

purvakarma.description: Drinking medicated ghee or oil in increasing doses every morning on an empty stomach to loosen toxins.
Full-body warm herbal oil massage to move loosened toxins towards the gastrointestinal tract.
Herbal steam therapy to dilate bodily channels (srotas) and facilitate the movement of toxins.
Eating a simple, mono-diet of Kitchari (mung beans and rice) to rest the digestive system (Agni) and prevent the formation of new Ama (toxins).
